Summary Hoo Pang Ron and Lai Pei Jing advanced to the second round of the French Open 2026 after defeating Chinese opponents Gao Jia Xuan and Wu Meng Ying.
 Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai Jemie were knocked out of the tournament by losing to Germany's Marvin Seidel and Thuc Phuong Nguyen.
 Ong Xin Yee and Carmen Ting reached the second round, with the possibility of facing fellow Malaysians Pearly Tan and M Thinaah.
 Make Malay Mail your preferred source on Google Giving you news that matter to Malaysians. Make Malay Mail your preferred source when you search for news on Google. First Published: Thursday, 22 Oct 2026 9:19 AM MYT × Subscribe to Newsletter
 Subscribe KUALA LUMPUR, Oct 22 — Professional mixed doubles pair Hoo Pang Ron-Lai Pei Jing made a winning start to their French Open 2026 campaign, battling back from a game down to reach the second round at Arena Grand Paris yesterday.
 Pang Ron-Pei Jing prevailed against China’s Gao Jia Xuan-Wu Meng Ying 14-21, 21-15, 21-15 in 46 minutes to set up a meeting with Taiwan’s Liu Kuang Heng-Hsu Yin-Hui, who stunned fifth seeds from Thailand Dechapol Puavaranukroh-Supissara Paewsampran 21-13, 22-24, 22-20.
 Unfortunately, husband-and-wife pair Goh Soon Huat-Shevon Lai Jemie suffered an early exit after failing to capitalise on winning their opening game 21-17 against Germany’s Marvin Seidel-Thuc Phuong Nguyen, losing the next two games 15-21, 20-22.
 Meanwhile, national women’s doubles pair Ong Xin Yee-Carmen Ting progressed to the second round as they trounced home pair Margot Lambert-Camille Pognante 21-11, 21-12.
 A potential all-Malaysian affair awaits Xin Yee-Carmen should national women’s doubles top pair and newly-crowned Denmark Open champion Pearly Tan-M Thinaah beat Turkish pair Bengisu Ercetin-Nazlizan Inci in the other first round tie.
 The French Open 2026 offers total prize money of US$950,000 (RM3.88 million). — Bernama
